title: R' Shmuel ben Yehotzadak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Berakhot, chapter 3, at the end of halakhah 1. Hyman calls this a scribal error: the name should read R' Shimon ben Yehotzadak, as in Nazir, chapter 7, halakhah 1.[^1]

notes.text: סה״א is contextually end of halakhah 1, not beginning or merely first halakhah. Both 3endh 1 and Nazir 7h 1 remain source locators without a verified modern edition; Jerusalem Talmud is suggested but not named. ט״ס and צ״ל conventionally mean scribal error and should-read, preserving Hyman’s definite correction from Shmuel to Shimon as his assertion. Machine מ״ס differs from supplied ט״ס, with no new source repair. The supplied heading remains Shmuel; both title abbreviations remain R'.
